name: Demon Of Desire
source:
“Sin, or destiny?”

A dark, sensual tale of identity, repression, and forbidden connection. You play as a young man who has buried his true self for 18 years—until now. As he begins to explore his sexuality, a mysterious bond with a seductive devil emerges. What begins as tension turns into trust… and something deeper.

[From [url=https://3kdesign.itch.io/demonofdesire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“罪孽，还是命运？”

一个关于身份、压抑和禁忌联系的黑暗、感性的故事。你扮演一个年轻人，他将真实的自我埋藏了18年——直到现在。当他开始探索自己的性取向时，与诱人魔鬼的神秘联系出现了。最初的紧张变成了信任……以及更深层次的东西。

[来自[url=https://3kdesign.itch.io/demonofdesire]Itch.io[/url]]
